rules.rule: Always include all required parameters and numeric values in correct units and formats.
Fully qualify receivers and services with all relevant tags in parentheses.
Convert time units to seconds as integer arguments, not milliseconds or strings.
Invoke services and receivers exactly as named without extra variables or assignments
Use full receiver context with all relevant tags in parentheses.
Use exact device and service identifiers with correct receiver syntax (#Device #Service).
Use numeric values grounded in seconds or milliseconds as required, not textual or approximate times.
Include all relevant receivers and services explicitly in the script call.
